# What does this PR do?

Adds an opt-in preflight check that reports, for a configurable set of process groups, each group's ranks, its hosts, and whether it spans nodes, and can warn or fail fast when a group that should stay on one node (tp by default) does not.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: related to #7627 (first step, topology only; psutil / pynvml resource checks are left for follow-ups)

cc @cspades, this follows your suggestion to cover dp as well and make the groups configurable.

## Design

- after `initialize_model_parallel`, each rank sends `(hostname, {name: group ranks})` through a single `all_gather_object` on the world group, so every rank has the same view and reaches the same decision
- group names map to `parallel_state` getters: `tp, pp, cp, dp, dp_cp, dp_replica, mp, tp_cp, tp_dp, tp_dp_cp, gtp_remat, ep, etp, tp_ep, ep_dp, embd, pos_embd, intra_dist_opt, inter_dist_opt`. groups that are not initialized are reported as skipped
- rank 0 prints one compact summary, e.g.

```
parallel topology check: world_size=16, nodes=2
  tp: 2 group(s) of size 8, 0 span nodes
  dp: 8 group(s) of size 2, 8 span nodes
    ranks [0, 8] on hosts ['node0', 'node1']
    ...
```

- flags (all in `DistributedInitConfig`):
  - `--preflight-check-parallel-topology {off,warn,error}` (default `off`, so existing runs are unchanged)
  - `--preflight-check-process-groups` groups to report (default `tp cp ep dp pp`, comma or space separated)
  - `--preflight-intra-node-process-groups` groups expected to stay within a node (default `tp`); with `warn` a spanning group logs a warning, with `error` every rank raises before training starts

## Code provenance

No external code.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run black, isort, pylint and ruff on the new files

## Testing

- `tests/unit_tests/test_parallel_topology_check.py`: 10 passed on cpu, using mocked hostnames and groups (2 nodes x 4 ranks) plus a single process gloo end to end run
- `tests/unit_tests/test_argument_utils.py` and `tests/unit_tests/training/test_initialization_lifecycle.py`: same results with and without this change on a cpu only box

@@ -166,6 +166,25 @@ class DistributedInitConfig:
     overlapped with other computation kernels.
     """
 
+    preflight_check_parallel_topology: Literal["off", "warn", "error"] = "off"
+    """Check how process groups are laid out across nodes after model parallel
+    initialization. A summary of `preflight_check_process_groups` is logged from rank 0.
+    If any group in `preflight_intra_node_process_groups` spans more than one node,
+    `warn` logs a warning and `error` stops the run before training starts.
+    """
+
+    preflight_check_process_groups: list[str] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: ["tp", "cp", "ep", "dp", "pp"]
+    )
+    """Process groups to include in the parallel topology summary, for example
+    `dp,cp,ep,tp,dp_cp`. Comma separated and space separated values are both accepted.
+    """
+
+    preflight_intra_node_process_groups: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["tp"])
+    """Process groups expected to stay within a single node. The parallel topology check
+    warns or fails if any of them spans nodes.
+    """
+
     distributed_timeout_seconds_after_init: int | None = None
     """Timeout in seconds for process groups after initialization. This timeout is applied to all process groups after initialization and the first iteration completes."""

@@ -491,6 +491,14 @@ def _initialize_distributed(get_embedding_ranks, get_position_embedding_ranks, s
                 f"> initialized pipeline model parallel with size "
                 f"{mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()}"
             )
+            if cfg.dist.preflight_check_parallel_topology != "off":
+                from megatron.training.parallel_topology_check import check_parallel_topology
+
+                check_parallel_topology(
+                    mode=cfg.dist.preflight_check_parallel_topology,
+                    process_groups=cfg.dist.preflight_check_process_groups,
+                    intra_node_process_groups=cfg.dist.preflight_intra_node_process_groups,
+                )
 
 
 def _init_autoresume():

@@ -0,0 +1,193 @@
+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Preflight check that reports how process groups are laid out across nodes.
+
+Each rank contributes its hostname and the global ranks of its selected process
+groups through a single ``all_gather_object`` on the world group. Every rank then
+holds the same view, so rank 0 can log a compact summary and every rank reaches
+the same decision when the check is configured to fail.
+"""
+
+import socket
+from typing import Callable, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core import parallel_state as mpu
+from megatron.training.utils import print_rank_0, warn_rank_0
+
+# Short names accepted on the command line, mapped to parallel_state getters.
+PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS: Dict[str, Callable[[], Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup]]] = {
+    "tp": lambda: mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_group(),
+    "pp": lambda: mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_group(),
+    "cp": lambda: mpu.get_context_parallel_group(),
+    "dp": lambda: mpu.get_data_parallel_group(),
+    "dp_cp": lambda: mpu.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True),
+    "dp_replica": lambda: mpu.get_data_parallel_group(with_gtp_remat=False),
+    "mp": lambda: mpu.get_model_parallel_group(),
+    "tp_cp": lambda: mpu.get_tensor_and_context_parallel_group(),
+    "tp_dp": lambda: mpu.get_tensor_and_data_parallel_group(),
+    "tp_dp_cp": lambda: mpu.get_tensor_and_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True),
+    "gtp_remat": lambda: mpu.get_gtp_weight_remat_group(),
+    "ep": lambda: mpu.get_expert_model_parallel_group(),
+    "etp": lambda: mpu.get_expert_tensor_parallel_group(),
+    "tp_ep": lambda: mpu.get_expert_tensor_and_model_parallel_group(),
+    "ep_dp": lambda: mpu.get_expert_data_parallel_group(),
+    "embd": lambda: mpu.get_embedding_group(),
+    "pos_embd": lambda: mpu.get_position_embedding_group(),
+    "intra_dist_opt": lambda: mpu.get_intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group(),
+    "inter_dist_opt": lambda: mpu.get_inter_distributed_optimizer_instance_group(),
+}
+
+MAX_LOGGED_SPANNING_GROUPS = 4
+
+
+def parse_process_group_names(names: Optional[Iterable[str]]) -> List[str]:
+    """Normalize a list of group names, allowing comma separated entries.
+
+    Args:
+        names: Names such as ``["dp,tp", "cp"]``.
+
+    Returns:
+        The deduplicated names in their original order.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If a name has no known getter.
+    """
+    parsed: List[str] = []
+    for entry in names or []:
+        for name in entry.split(","):
+            name = name.strip().lower()
+            if not name or name in parsed:
+                continue
+            if name not in PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Unknown process group '{name}' for the parallel topology check. "
+                    f"Valid names: {', '.join(sorted(PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS))}."
+                )
+            parsed.append(name)
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _local_group_ranks(names: Sequence[str]) -> Dict[str, Optional[Tuple[int, ...]]]:
+    """Return the global ranks of this rank's group for each name, or None if unavailable."""
+    local: Dict[str, Optional[Tuple[int, ...]]] = {}
+    for name in names:
+        try:
+            group = PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS[name]()
+        except (AssertionError, RuntimeError):
+            group = None
+        if group is None:
+            local[name] = None
+            continue
+        local[name] = tuple(torch.distributed.get_process_group_ranks(group))
+    return local
+
+
+def summarize_topology(
+    hostnames: Sequence[str],
+    gathered_groups: Sequence[Dict[str, Optional[Tuple[int, ...]]]],
+    names: Sequence[str],
+) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
+    """Build a per-name summary from the gathered hostnames and group ranks.
+
+    Args:
+        hostnames: Hostname of every global rank, indexed by rank.
+        gathered_groups: For every global rank, its group ranks keyed by name.
+        names: Group names to summarize.
+
+    Returns:
+        A dict keyed by group name with the unique groups, their hosts and the
+        groups that span more than one node.
+    """
+    summary: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
+    for name in names:
+        unique = sorted({g[name] for g in gathered_groups if g.get(name) is not None})
+        groups = []
+        for ranks in unique:
+            hosts = sorted({hostnames[r] for r in ranks})
+            groups.append({"ranks": list(ranks), "hosts": hosts, "spans_nodes": len(hosts) > 1})
+        summary[name] = {"groups": groups, "spanning": [g for g in groups if g["spans_nodes"]]}
+    return summary
+
+
+def format_summary(summary: Dict[str, Dict], num_nodes: int, world_size: int) -> str:
+    """Render a compact, human readable report of the summary."""
+    lines = [f"parallel topology check: world_size={world_size}, nodes={num_nodes}"]
+    for name, info in summary.items():
+        groups = info["groups"]
+        if not groups:
+            lines.append(f"  {name}: not initialized, skipped")
+            continue
+        sizes = sorted({len(g["ranks"]) for g in groups})
+        size_str = "/".join(str(s) for s in sizes)
+        lines.append(
+            f"  {name}: {len(groups)} group(s) of size {size_str}, "
+            f"{len(info['spanning'])} span nodes"
+        )
+        for g in info["spanning"][:MAX_LOGGED_SPANNING_GROUPS]:
+            lines.append(f"    ranks {g['ranks']} on hosts {g['hosts']}")
+        extra = len(info["spanning"]) - MAX_LOGGED_SPANNING_GROUPS
+        if extra > 0:
+            lines.append(f"    ... {extra} more spanning group(s)")
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def check_parallel_topology(
+    mode: str = "off",
+    process_groups: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
+    intra_node_process_groups: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
+) -> Optional[Dict[str, Dict]]:
+    """Report which process groups span nodes, optionally warning or failing.
+
+    The summary for ``process_groups`` is logged from rank 0. Groups listed in
+    ``intra_node_process_groups`` are expected to stay on one node; if any of
+    them spans nodes, ``mode="warn"`` logs a warning and ``mode="error"`` raises
+    on every rank.
+
+    Args:
+        mode: One of ``off``, ``warn`` or ``error``.
+        process_groups: Group names to report, comma separated entries allowed.
+        intra_node_process_groups: Group names expected to stay within a node.
+
+    Returns:
+        The summary dict, or None when the check is off.
+    """
+    if mode == "off":
+        return None
+    if mode not in ("warn", "error"):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown parallel topology check mode '{mode}'.")
+
+    report_names = parse_process_group_names(process_groups)
+    intra_names = parse_process_group_names(intra_node_process_groups)
+    names = report_names + [n for n in intra_names if n not in report_names]
+    if not names:
+        return None
+
+    payload = (socket.gethostname(), _local_group_ranks(names))
+    world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+    gathered: List = [None] * world_size
+    torch.distributed.all_gather_object(gathered, payload)
+    hostnames = [p[0] for p in gathered]
+    summary = summarize_topology(hostnames, [p[1] for p in gathered], names)
+
+    if report_names:
+        report = {n: summary[n] for n in report_names}
+        print_rank_0(format_summary(report, len(set(hostnames)), world_size))
+
+    offending = [n for n in intra_names if summary[n]["spanning"]]
+    if offending:
+        msg = (
+            "parallel topology check: process group(s) "
+            f"{', '.join(offending)} span multiple nodes, which usually means "
+            "intra-node communication is going over the inter-node network. "
+            + "; ".join(
+                f"{n}: ranks {summary[n]['spanning'][0]['ranks']} on hosts "
+                f"{summary[n]['spanning'][0]['hosts']}"
+                for n in offending
+            )
+        )
+        if mode == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(msg)
+        warn_rank_0(msg)
+    return summary

@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.training import parallel_topology_check as ptc
+
+
+def _simulate_world(hostnames, layouts):
+    """Patch torch.distributed so the check sees a fake world.
+
+    Args:
+        hostnames: Hostname per global rank.
+        layouts: Group name to a list of rank lists that partition the world.
+    """
+
+    def payload_for(rank):
+        groups = {}
+        for name, partition in layouts.items():
+            groups[name] = next((tuple(g) for g in partition if rank in g), None)
+        return hostnames[rank], groups
+
+    def fake_all_gather_object(output, obj):
+        for rank in range(len(hostnames)):
+            output[rank] = payload_for(rank)
+
+    patches = [
+        mock.patch.object(torch.distributed, "get_world_size", return_value=len(hostnames)),
+        mock.patch.object(torch.distributed, "get_rank", return_value=0),
+        mock.patch.object(torch.distributed, "all_gather_object", fake_all_gather_object),
+        mock.patch.object(ptc, "_local_group_ranks", lambda names: payload_for(0)[1]),
+        mock.patch.object(ptc.socket, "gethostname", return_value=hostnames[0]),
+    ]
+    return patches
+
+
+def _run(hostnames, layouts, **kwargs):
+    patches = _simulate_world(hostnames, layouts)
+    for p in patches:
+        p.start()
+    try:
+        return ptc.check_parallel_topology(**kwargs)
+    finally:
+        for p in patches:
+            p.stop()
+
+
+# 2 nodes x 4 gpus.
+HOSTS = ["node0"] * 4 + ["node1"] * 4
+
+
+def test_parse_process_group_names_accepts_commas_and_dedupes():
+    assert ptc.parse_process_group_names(["dp,tp", "cp", "tp", " ep "]) == ["dp", "tp", "cp", "ep"]
+    assert ptc.parse_process_group_names(None) == []
+
+
+def test_parse_process_group_names_rejects_unknown():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown process group 'foo'"):
+        ptc.parse_process_group_names(["tp,foo"])
+
+
+def test_off_mode_does_nothing():
+    with mock.patch.object(torch.distributed, "all_gather_object") as gather:
+        assert ptc.check_parallel_topology(mode="off", process_groups=["tp"]) is None
+        gather.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_summary_reports_ranks_hosts_and_spanning(capsys):
+    layouts = {"tp": [[0, 1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7]], "dp": [[0, 4], [1, 5], [2, 6], [3, 7]]}
+    with mock.patch.object(ptc, "print_rank_0", side_effect=print):
+        summary = _run(
+            HOSTS, layouts, mode="warn", process_groups=["tp,dp"], intra_node_process_groups=["tp"]
+        )
+    assert [g["ranks"] for g in summary["tp"]["groups"]] == [[0, 1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7]]
+    assert summary["tp"]["spanning"] == []
+    assert len(summary["dp"]["spanning"]) == 4
+    assert summary["dp"]["groups"][0]["hosts"] == ["node0", "node1"]
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "nodes=2" in out
+    assert "tp: 2 group(s) of size 4, 0 span nodes" in out
+    assert "dp: 4 group(s) of size 2, 4 span nodes" in out
+
+
+def test_warn_mode_warns_when_intra_node_group_spans_nodes():
+    # tp=8 on 4 gpu nodes spans both nodes.
+    layouts = {"tp": [list(range(8))]}
+    with mock.patch.object(ptc, "warn_rank_0") as warn, mock.patch.object(ptc, "print_rank_0"):
+        summary = _run(
+            HOSTS, layouts, mode="warn", process_groups=["tp"], intra_node_process_groups=["tp"]
+        )
+    assert len(summary["tp"]["spanning"]) == 1
+    warn.assert_called_once()
+    assert "tp" in warn.call_args[0][0]
+
+
+def test_error_mode_raises_when_intra_node_group_spans_nodes():
+    layouts = {"tp": [[0, 1, 4, 5], [2, 3, 6, 7]]}
+    with mock.patch.object(ptc, "print_rank_0"):
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="span multiple nodes"):
+            _run(HOSTS, layouts, mode="error", process_groups=[], intra_node_process_groups=["tp"])
+
+
+def test_error_mode_passes_when_only_reported_groups_span():
+    layouts = {"tp": [[0, 1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7]], "dp": [[0, 4], [1, 5], [2, 6], [3, 7]]}
+    with mock.patch.object(ptc, "print_rank_0"):
+        summary = _run(
+            HOSTS, layouts, mode="error", process_groups=["dp"], intra_node_process_groups=["tp"]
+        )
+    assert summary["tp"]["spanning"] == []
+
+
+def test_uninitialized_group_is_skipped(capsys):
+    layouts = {"tp": [[0, 1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7]], "ep": []}
+    with mock.patch.object(ptc, "print_rank_0", side_effect=print):
+        summary = _run(
+            HOSTS, layouts, mode="warn", process_groups=["tp,ep"], intra_node_process_groups=[]
+        )
+    assert summary["ep"]["groups"] == []
+    assert "ep: not initialized, skipped" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_local_group_ranks_handles_missing_groups():
+    sentinel = object()
+    getters = {
+        "tp": lambda: sentinel,
+        "cp": lambda: None,
+        "ep": mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError),
+    }
+    with (
+        mock.patch.dict(ptc.PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS, getters),
+        mock.patch.object(torch.distributed, "get_process_group_ranks", return_value=[0, 1]),
+    ):
+        assert ptc._local_group_ranks(["tp", "cp", "ep"]) == {"tp": (0, 1), "cp": None, "ep": None}
+
+
+def test_single_process_gloo_end_to_end(tmp_path):
+    if torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+        pytest.skip("distributed already initialized")
+    torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+        "gloo", init_method=f"file://{tmp_path}/store", rank=0, world_size=1
+    )
+    try:
+        world = torch.distributed.group.WORLD
+        with mock.patch.dict(ptc.PROCESS_GROUP_GETTERS, {"tp": lambda: world, "dp": lambda: world}):
+            summary = ptc.check_parallel_topology(
+                mode="error", process_groups=["tp,dp"], intra_node_process_groups=["tp"]
+            )
+        assert summary["tp"]["groups"][0]["ranks"] == [0]
+        assert summary["tp"]["spanning"] == []
+    finally:
+        torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
